_what_this_is: Example ingest config for the approved 12-clip base pack. Copy it next to the delivered clip files, fill in the real entries, and pass it to build_perturbation_pack.py --ingest-config. Paths are relative to this file. Nothing here is a defect label: clip_id, regions and shots are identity and geometry, and the truth of every fixture still comes from the transformation that builds it.
_frozen_requirement: eval/v1/instruments/RESOURCE-REQUESTS.yaml family 4: >=12 clips, 6-20 seconds, each containing a person, a product and on-screen text, with >=2 clips that cut between shots.
_fps_note: target_fps normalises every clip to one integer frame rate so that 'the defect is at frame 41' is unambiguous. It is recorded as a condition of any qualification earned on this pack.

clips.rights_ref: fill in the Resources rights record id; a clip with no rights record must not be ingested

regions._note: optional. A bounding box says WHERE to look, never that anything is wrong. Omit them and ingest defaults boxes from frame geometry and records region_source: geometric_default. Declared boxes are strongly preferred for real footage: a defaulted box that lands on a featureless area cannot carry a text or product perturbation at all, and the pack will record that gap rather than invent a fixture.

clips._shots_note: "auto" runs the deterministic, threshold-recorded cut detector. A list such as [[0,120],[120,264]] declares boundaries explicitly. Omit the field entirely to treat the clip as one shot, which makes shot_horizontal_flip unavailable for it.
